newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur names Thomas Wellauer new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur names Thomas Wellauer new CEO.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co said Thomas Wellauer had been chosen to succeed Peter Spaelti as chief executive of the Swiss market leader in direct insurance.
A Winterthur spokesman confirmed the report in Wednesday's edition of the Zurich newspaper Tages-Anzeiger but said no more details would be released until later in the day.
It was not immediately clear when the succession would take place.
The newspaper said Spaelti had chosen Wellauer.
It said Wellauer, aged 42, was now a corporate consultant with McKinsey & Co Inc, where he was in charge of covering Winterthur and its banking industry partner Credit Suisse Group .

Winterthur is a leading European direct insurer with a strong position as well in the United States and China, where it became the first European insurer to win a non-life operating licence last year.
The group sealed an extensive cooperation deal with Credit Suisse at the end of 1995 for one-stop financing in areas inclusing occupational insurance and international corporate services.
